name: NeurIPS & ICML Computational Science & Mathematical Proof Checklist
authority: NeurIPS Paper Checklist / Association for Computing Machinery (ACM)
domain: Machine Learning, Computational Math, Algorithms & SMT Verification

criteria.name: Claims vs. Empirical/Formal Evidence
criteria.description: All theoretical claims, master laws, and performance bounds are directly backed by complete mathematical proofs, simulation suites, or empirical datasets.

criteria.name: Limitations & Structural Failure Boundaries
criteria.description: Explicitly discusses boundary conditions, failure modes, frozen criteria breaches, and theoretical regime limits where the model breaks down.

criteria.name: Theoretical Assumptions & Mathematical Rigor
criteria.description: All mathematical assumptions (ergodicity, stationarity, Lipschitz continuity, contraction mappings) are explicitly stated with formal proofs.

criteria.name: Code Reproducibility & Environment Dependency
criteria.description: Full source code, environment manifests (requirements/Pipfile/Conda), and execution entry points are provided for 100% bit-exact replication.

criteria.name: Data Documentation & Provenance Licensing
criteria.description: All public datasets (e.g., connectomes, genomic eQTLs, CFPB registers) are documented with exact versioning, access dates, and open licenses.

criteria.name: Random Seeds, Permutations & Error Bars
criteria.description: All stochastic simulations report results across multiple fixed random seeds (N >= 5) with variance bounds, confidence intervals, and shuffle controls.

criteria.name: Hyperparameter Specification & Sensitivity Analysis
criteria.description: All parameters (learning rate lambda, coupling K, threshold eta) are explicitly listed with parameter recovery and sensitivity scans.

criteria.name: Compute Resources & Computational Complexity
criteria.description: Reports asymptotic computational complexity (Big-O), memory footprint, execution times, and hardware requirements.

criteria.name: Competitive Incumbent Baseline Benchmarks
criteria.description: Compares directly against competitive existing algorithms or baseline models (e.g., Rescorla-Wagner, DDM, HGF, standard credit scoring) under fair parity.

criteria.name: Formal Methods & SMT Machine Verification
criteria.description: Employs automated theorem proving (Z3 SMT solver, Lean 4, or SymPy CAS) to certify mathematical invariants and boundary conditions.
